blurb: Wild Heaven Beer brews culinary and botanically-driven beers inspired by European tradition with a southern flair. They operate three taprooms in Metro Atlanta: West End, Toco Hills, and Avondale. Each location offers craft beers, house-made hard cider, seltzers, cocktails, and Georgia wines, along with food from local restaurant partners.
